theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_angle_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ y : Euclid P, ‖Q.starProjection y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ y a ^ 2 + inner ℝ y e ^ 2) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x ∧ ∀ v : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x v = inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2
